verdict.rationale: Column documents webhooks that notify a developer's endpoint about events. That is a building block the developer would wire up to their own logic, not a product feature for defining rules that trigger actions automatically. Holds, overdraft settings, per-account ACH limits and automatic monthly statements are adjacent controls or fixed behaviors, not user-defined event-triggered rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
